notes: Roadmap tickets for mobile-first launch with central backend and staged web admin.

tickets.title: Define product tiers and feature flags
tickets.description: Lock Starter, Growth, and Pro scope and map each feature to a runtime flag.
acceptanceCriteria: Tier matrix approved by team
Each premium feature mapped to a flag key
Out-of-scope items parked in backlog

tickets.title: Set up backend project and environments
tickets.description: Create backend service, dev/stage/prod environments, and secret management.
acceptanceCriteria: Backend repo initialized
Dev and stage environments working
Secrets are not stored in source control

tickets.title: Create core database schema
tickets.description: Implement tables for companies, users, vehicles, items, and item_movements with indexes.
acceptanceCriteria: Migration scripts created
Foreign keys and indexes in place
Seed script for local dev

tickets.title: Implement auth and company scoping
tickets.description: Add sign-in and enforce multi-tenant company scoping on all queries.
acceptanceCriteria: Users can sign in and receive tokens
Requests cannot read data from other companies
Integration tests cover tenant isolation

tickets.title: Build API for items, vehicles, and movement log
tickets.description: Expose CRUD endpoints plus append-only movement events with timestamps and actor.
acceptanceCriteria: OpenAPI spec published
API supports list/filter for mobile needs
Movement events are immutable

tickets.title: Wire mobile app to backend sync
tickets.description: Replace local-only state with online sync and offline queue for changes.
acceptanceCriteria: App reads from backend after login
Creates and moves sync correctly
Offline changes replay when connection returns

tickets.title: Implement role model (Admin and Field User)
tickets.description: Add role-based access for admin workflows versus field workflows.
acceptanceCriteria: Role claims included in auth token
Admin-only endpoints blocked for field users
Permission matrix documented

tickets.title: Create web admin skeleton
tickets.description: Create a basic web app with login and protected admin layout.
acceptanceCriteria: Admin can sign in
Navigation for Items, Vehicles, Movements
Unauthorized users are redirected

tickets.title: Build web list and search views
tickets.description: Implement table views with filters for tools, vehicles, and latest movements.
acceptanceCriteria: Search by tool name and serial
Filter by vehicle or assigned person
Movement list sorted by newest first

tickets.title: Add Starter and Growth billing gates
tickets.description: Enforce plan limits and feature gates for user and vehicle caps plus web admin access.
acceptanceCriteria: Plan limits are validated server-side
Starter cannot access Growth-only web features
Upgrade path messaging shown in app and web

tickets.title: Add operational reports
tickets.description: Create reports for missing items and inactive items over configurable days.
acceptanceCriteria: Missing items report available
Inactive items report configurable
CSV export works for both reports

tickets.title: Add Pro features: handover confirmation and incident photos
tickets.description: Track accepted handovers with signature/ack and support damage or loss photo evidence.
acceptanceCriteria: Handover event includes from/to, time, and confirmation
Incident photos stored with metadata
Pro flag required to use these flows
